title: Pollard's theorem in general abelian groups
summary: We make further progress towards a Kneser-type generalization of Pollard's Theorem to general abelian groups. For two sets $A$ and $B$ in an abelian group $G$, the \emph{$t$-popular sumset} of $A$ and $B$, denoted by $A+_t B$, is the set of elements in $G$ each with at least $t$ representations of the form $a+b$, where $a\in A$ and $b\in B$.
